en: The ancient secret behind this mystery is called... Tummo, or inner fire meditation.

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: Handed down for thousands of years in the Tibetan Buddhist tradition, this practice is also called Chandali yoga.

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: Lamas who practise it live in mountain caves in sub-zero cold, wearing only thin cloth.

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: Hearing of this, a leading professor at Harvard Medical School, Dr. Herbert Benson...

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: went to the Himalayas himself with his research team in 1982.

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: The scientists had one question... is this a real biological fact, or are they playing some trick?

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: They fixed highly sensitive digital thermometers to the monks' fingers, toes and chests.

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: Normally, in severe cold, finger temperature drops.

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: But as soon as the monks began Tummo meditation... a wonder happened before the doctors' eyes!

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: The temperature of the monks' fingers rose steadily... by a full eight to seventeen degrees Fahrenheit!

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: Even in freezing cold, heat like a central heating system was being generated inside their bodies!

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: Unable to believe it, the scientists ran a more extreme test.

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: They put wet cloths dipped in ice water on their shoulders.

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: A normal person would go into shock from that cold.

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: But within forty-five minutes... steam rose from the monks' bodies and the wet cloths dried completely!

pause_use: cut on the breath; music bed lifts, whoosh/impact on the cut
en: The Harvard doctors wrote in their research papers:
this is undeniable proof that a person can control the human autonomic nervous system with the power of the mind!
